# .github/workflows

Planned workflows (YAML wires credentials only; logic lives in `tools/`). Every job that runs repository code sets up Bun with `oven-sh/setup-bun` — there is no Node matrix. (`release.yml`'s `github-release` job runs none: it only downloads the compiled artifacts and calls `gh`.) Action majors, the Bun version, a `timeout-minutes` on every job, and `persist-credentials: false` on every checkout are enforced by `tools/validate/workflows.ts` (wired into `ci:validate`), which also rejects a job key that has drifted into a trigger block: valid YAML that GitHub silently ignores.

- `validate.yml` — PRs + main: runs the single root script `bun run ci:validate` (check, typecheck, `bun test`, knip) verbatim.
- `secret-scan.yml` — PRs + main: gitleaks over the commits the event introduced (`tools/security/`).
- `auto-release.yml` — on main pushes (unless `[skip release]` / `github-actions[bot]`): gitleaks → bump next minor in the shipped package manifests → tag → `workflow_call` into `release.yml`. Shares the `release` concurrency group. Recovery: dispatch with an existing `v*` tag.
- `release.yml` — compile → smoke (ubuntu + macos) → GitHub Release → npm Trusted Publishing. Triggered by a hand-pushed `v*` tag, tag-ref `workflow_dispatch`, or `workflow_call` from auto-release. Tag + publish stay in **one** reusable path (`GITHUB_TOKEN`-pushed tags don't trigger sibling workflows); `concurrency: cancel-in-progress: false` so channels never interleave; `tools/release/preflight.ts` checks every package already exists on npm first, because Trusted Publishing cannot create one and answers a bare 404 when it tries.
- `deploy-site.yml` — on main pushes touching `apps/web`, `packages/core`, or `packages/toolbar`: revalidates, builds, and `wrangler deploy`s the pinbox.sh Worker (the marketing site and the demo hub are one Worker). Filtered on core and toolbar too, because the Worker bundles both. `concurrency: cancel-in-progress: false` — a half-applied Worker upload costs more than the minute saved. Two jobs on purpose: everything that runs the repo's own code (install, `ci:validate`) runs in `verify`, which holds no credentials; `deploy` holds them and runs only the build and wrangler, which cannot move because wrangler bundles from source at deploy time. Needs `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` on the `site - prod` environment; the Worker's own secrets (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `WEBHOOK_SECRET`) are set once with `wrangler secret put` and survive deploys.
- `docs-sync.yml` — on main pushes touching the CLI: regenerates `skills/pinbox/SKILL.md` + CLI docs via `tools/skillgen` and opens a PR on drift.
